notablePrerequisites: You have gained 3 or more life this turn.
easyPrerequisites: Will, Scion of Peace does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Will by tapping it, causing white and blue spells you cast this turn to cost at least {3} less.
Cast Recruit the Worthy with buyback by paying {W}, creating three 1/1 Soldier creature tokens and returning Recruit the Worthy to your hand.
Activate Prosperous Partnership by tapping the three Soldiers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat from step 2.
